title: Polymorphed (status group)
html:
This page is about the status group. For the condition, see Polymorphed (Condition).

Polymorphed is a status group.  Polymorphed is the representative condition for the type. This status group usually contains conditions that transform's the affected entities' body or shape.

Immunity

The following passive features grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Immutable Existence
  •  Immutable Form

List of conditions in Polymorphed

Condition Effects
Aberrant Shape
  • Your Intellect Devourer form has 21 Hit Points.
  • You gain the  Claws,  Devour Intellect, and  Synaptic Discharge abilities.
Alternate Form: Dire Wolf
  • Transformed into a Dire Wolf in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Minotaur
  • Transformed into a Minotaur in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Phase Spider
  • Transformed into a Phase Spider in all the ways that matter.
Alternate Form: Shadow Mastiff
  • Transformed into a Shadow Mastiff in all the ways that matter.
Big Pig
  • Pigs are smart and pigs are fun - that's why Dolly made you one!
Blinked to the Ethereal Plane
  • Affected entity is in the  Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected.
  • While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft).
  • At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
Cattle Prattle
  • Want to converse like a cow? Dolly Thrice will show you how.
Dammon's Special Brew
  • Dammon's concoction enrages the owlbear.
Disguise Self
  • Appearance is entirely changed.
Displacer Beast Form
  • Affected entity has adopted the eldritch pantherlike form of a displace beast.
Gaseous Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist.
  • Resistant to all non-magical damage.
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength  Saving Throws.
  • Becomes Tiny in size.
  • Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak.
  • The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
Heartform Terror: Spider
  • This creature has twisted its form into one of your fears.
Heartform Terror: Wolf
  • This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.
Heartform Terror: Wolf
  • This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.
Infiltration Expertise
  • Appearance is entirely changed.
Magic Allergy: Panther Polymorph
  • This gremishka has been polymorphed into a panther.
Mist Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist, now immune to all non-magical damage. This status is removed by sunlight.
Polymorph
  • You are now a particularly ripe wheel of cheese, unpleasant to the nostril.
Polymorph Self
  • Transformed into a blue jay, able to  Fly for 5 rounds.
Polymorphed
  • Creature is turned into a harmless sheep with 3 Hit Points for 5 turns.
  • If the sheep's Hit Points are reduced to 0, the creature reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.
Polymorphed
  • Changed into a beast.
Polymorphed: Dire Raven
  • Polymorphed into a Dire Raven
Potent Mist Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist, now immune to all non-magical damage and resistant to magical damage.
  • Possibly  Blind foes within 4 m (13 ft) and inflict 3d6⁠⁠Necrotic at the start of their turn.
  • This condition is removed by sunlight.
Seeming
  • Appearance is entirely changed.
Shapechanged
  • This creature has shapechanged into a male human.
Slayer Form
  • Affected entity has embraced its savage compulsions, allowing it to assume its Slayer form.
Starry Form: Archer
  • In Starry Form. As a Bonus Action, you can cast  Luminous Arrow.
Starry Form: Chalice
  • In Starry Form. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast  Chalice Healing.
Starry Form: Dragon
  • In Starry Form. When you make a Saving Throw to maintain Concentration on a spell, a roll result of 9 or lower is considered a 10.
  • As a Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast  Dazzling Breath.
Toad Mode
  • If you do not want to think, Dolly Thrice will make you shrink.
Vampire Bat Form
  • Polymorphed into a vampire bat
Wild Magic: Cat Form
  • Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a cat.
Wild Magic: Dog Form
  • Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a dog.
Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon
  • Wild shaped into an Air Myrmidon
